---
name: Design feedback
about: An objection to a specific RFC/ADR/spec section, or a case it doesn't handle
title: ''
labels: design
assignees: ''
---

**Which document and section**
e.g. `docs/rfc/0011-declared-boundaries-and-the-width-of-enforcement.md` §6

**The specific case**
A concrete scenario where the proposal as written breaks, is ambiguous, or produces the wrong
outcome. General preference ("I don't like X") is less useful than a case that falsifies a claim.

**What you'd propose instead, if anything**
Optional — even just the falsifying case is useful.
